# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version of Donut Teams on
the default branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
on this repository so maintainers can investigate before public disclosure.

Include steps to reproduce, affected versions, and impact when possible.
